title: HomeGuard Journal - Security Tips
content: General advice for neighborhood security: Keep exterior lights on at night, consider installing motion sensors, and regularly check that all doors and windows are locked before leaving the house or going to bed. It's also wise to vary your routine to avoid predictability. For personal home security systems, ensure that the alarm codes are kept confidential and that security cameras cover all potential entry points. Upcoming Neighborhood Watch meetings are scheduled for March 5th, 12th, and 19th at 7 PM at the community center.

title: HomeGuard Journal - My Home Setup
content: I've installed high-security locks on all doors, which are top-rated for anti-pick and anti-bump. My alarm system code is personalized, which I'll need to change quarterly. The only back door is the chimney - it should be fine. The security cameras are strategically placed but provide full coverage of the front yard, back yard, and all entry points. I've also set up notifications for any movement detected during night hours.
